Will the next card be higher or lower? (Aces high, ties lose)

📖 How to use

  1. Look at the current card and guess Higher or Lower.
  2. Correct guesses build your streak.
  3. Ties count as wrong — Aces are high.
  4. Wrong guess ends the round — beat your best!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the deck work?

A full 52-card deck, shuffled. Aces are high, ties count as wrong guesses.

How is the streak scored?

Each correct guess adds 1 to your streak. The deck reshuffles automatically when it runs out.

What ends a round?

A wrong guess (including ties) ends the round and shows your final score.

Can I see how many cards are left?

Yes — the remaining card count is shown so you know when a reshuffle is coming.
